title: Sri Kurmanathaswamy Temple, Srikurmam
geometryBasis: The OpenStreetMap multipolygon provides the precinct perimeter and an open courtyard around the projecting temple. The named worship point and camera coordinates link the photographed shrine, north-facing temple side, courtyard range, and exterior wall to this site.
sectionBasis: The original Qualla photograph and three exact same-day CC0 originals document the carved stone tiers, weathered stone courses, flat roofed corridors, pillars and brass flagstaff. Government accounts describe the sculptured pillars and eight-petaled sanctum crown. Individual reliefs and the section heights are estimated.
limitations: The July 2021 model covers the mapped temple and courtyard ranges. Heights, roof subdivisions, column spacing and individual relief figures are interpreted from the cleared views. Ornament is simplified at medium fidelity. Detached structures, the tank pavilion, tortoise enclosure and interior shrine contents are excluded.
Original source elevation samples are preserved. The modeled court pavement and entry threshold are approximate. Ground contact varies slightly around the precinct perimeter.
